entities.summary: Silje Nergaard (b. 1966-06-19, Steinkjer Municipality) was a visual artist or sculptor of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in Steinkjer Municipality and Norway. Known in the fields of norway, composers & musicians, europe.
